messages:
Jules: ok tiny idea  "Adopt-a-Desk-Plant" + origami ornament craft swap. low-effort: bring a small plant or a photo of your plant if remote, and fold one origami star/ornament to swap. optional shipping. :seedling::star:
Mei: i'm so in. i've been meaning to name my office philodendron. can remote folks join w/ photos + a little care note?
Owen: yes remote welcome. i'd rather send a packet of seeds than baked goods. allergy-friendly and lightweight.
Nadia: logistics thought: opt-in form (name + in-office/remote + plant/photo + ship ok?) and a checkbox for whether you want to be revealed or stay anonymous. also, tiny care tags please (water once a week etc.).
festive-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Adopt-a-Desk-Plant & Origami Ornament Swap" Thu 4:00 PM PT  RSVP by Wed 5PM.
Jules: poll  react to pick a tiny theme: :evergreen_tree: Cozy Green, :sparkles: Handmade Ornaments, :package: Seed Packets. react to vote.
Mei: voted :evergreen_tree:. also propose a micro-legend board: each plant gets a one-line origin story (e.g., "rescued from a grocery store sale").
Owen: signup (30s): https://tinyurl.com/rw-plant-adopt (name + in-office/remote + prefer gift type + reveal yes/no)
Nadia: in-office dropoff details:
```
Drop table: 4th floor lounge
Drop window: Thu 9am-2pm
Label: name + "plant" or "photo" + care notes
```
Jules: shipping deadline (US) Wed EOD for seed/ornament swaps. remote folks: a high-res photo + care note works great if shipping isn't possible.
Mei: tiny origami tip: fold a simple 5-point star and slip it into a small envelope with a micro-note. i can run a 5-min demo video for anyone who wants to try. :scissors:
Owen: allergy/plant safety reminder: please avoid anything not labeled (no unmarked compostable cakes). if you're gifting soil, use sealed bags.
Nadia: i'll compile a little "plant roster" with photos and care notes and post in #random after the swap (with consent).
Jules: optional reveal hangout Thu 4:15 PT for 10 min  show your plant, say one line about why you picked it. totally optional. :potted_plant:
Mei: love it. i'll bring a tiny pack of plant food for in-office winners (raffle for cute origami).
Owen: excited! i'll DM folks with shipping questions. thanks for organizing, Jules. :seedling:
